- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several types of wood for trellis stakes: cedar, cypress, redwood, and pressure-treated lumber.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the benefits of each wood type, including resistance to rot and decay.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised avoiding softwoods like pine, fir, and spruce due to their susceptibility to rot.
